requirements.quote:
To facilitate this, it is a useful optimization to order
   the path attributes according to type code.  This optimization is
   entirely optional.
requirements.condition: When choosing the optional path-attribute ordering optimization to facilitate identifying semantically identical attribute sets across UPDATE messages
requirements.required_behavior: MAY order path attributes according to type code; this optimization is entirely optional.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional serialization ordering can be checked by comparing the type codes of emitted path attributes; absence of this optimization is permitted.
